step1_analysis.circuit_type: Fully Differential Folded Cascode Operational Amplifier
step1_analysis.description: A fully differential folded cascode op-amp with an NMOS input pair and a double-cascode PMOS folded branch. It is designed to achieve high gain in a single stage, likely used in the multiplying digital-to-analog converter (MDAC) of the pipelined ADC.

paper_reference.title: A 12-Bit 20-Msample/s Pipelined Analog-to-Digital Converter With Nested Digital Background Calibration

paper_reported.value: 70.8 dB (System SNDR, implies op-amp gain > 72 dB)

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm1 * Rout. Rout is dominated by the NMOS cascode (gm11 * ro11 * ro13). With L=0.5um, intrinsic gain gm*ro is ~30. Rout ~ 900 * ro. Gain ~ 30 * 900 = 27000 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A 12-bit ADC requires at least 72 dB of open-loop gain to keep gain error below 1 LSB. The double PMOS cascode and single NMOS cascode provide very high output impedance.

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = gm1 / (2 * pi * CL). For Id=70uA, gm1 ~ 0.8mA/V. With CL=1pF, GBW = 0.8m / (2*pi*1p) ~ 127 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: To settle to 12-bit accuracy within a 25ns half-period (20 MS/s), the closed-loop bandwidth must be > 100 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the non-dominant pole at the folding node (N1, N2).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard requirement for stable settling without excessive ringing in switched-capacitor circuits.

power_consumption.description: Total static power dissipation of the op-amp

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current = I_tail + 2*I_folded. I_tail ~ 140uA, I_folded ~ 100uA each. Total I ~ 340uA. Power = 340uA * 1.8V = 0.61 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply. The op-amp consumes a small fraction of the total 254 mW reported for the entire ADC.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC operating point, open-loop AC response (Gain, GBW, Phase Margin), and transient response of the fully differential folded cascode op-amp.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Fully Differential Folded Cascode Op-Amp

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Adjusted W/L to balance PMOS and NMOS drive strengths
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=25u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=25u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=25u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=25u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=25u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=25u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 VIP N3 GNDA sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 VIN N3 GNDA sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 VCMFB GNDA GNDA sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 VB5 GNDA GNDA sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 VB1 VDDA VDDA sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 VB1 VDDA VDDA sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 VB2 N1 VDDA sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N5 VB2 N2 VDDA sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 VON VB3 N4 VDDA sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 VOP VB3 N5 VDDA sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 VON VB4 N6 GNDA sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 VOP VB4 N7 GNDA sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N6 VB5 GNDA GNDA sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N7 VB5 GNDA GNDA sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

* Power Supplies
VDDA VDDA 0 1.8
VGNDA GNDA 0 0

* Biasing (Optimized for SKY130 1.8V)
VVB1 VB1 0 1.1
VVB2 VB2 0 0.8
VVB3 VB3 0 0.5
VVB4 VB4 0 0.9
VVB5 VB5 0 0.61

* Ideal Common-Mode Feedback (Regulates output CM to 0.9V)
Bcmfb VCMFB 0 V=0.61 + (v(VOP)+v(VON)-1.8)*10

* Input Signals
VVIP VIP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.05 1MEG 0 0 0)
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 0.05 1MEG 0 0 180)

* Load Capacitance
CL1 VOP 0 1p
CL2 VON 0 1p

* Differential Output Voltage
Bout VOUT 0 V=v(VOP)-v(VON)

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
print v(VOP) v(VON) v(VCMFB)
let power = -i(VDDA) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(VOUT)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUT))
let pm = 180 + phase
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_margin find pm when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 1n 5u
meas tran vout_pp pp v(VOUT)

quit
.endc
